manifest.name: V13-mlp-unsloth-bytes
manifest.description: Same precision map as V0 (NVFP4 everywhere), but MLP layers 0-55 use unsloth's calibrated NVFP4 bytes (llm-compressor, actorder static) instead of the baseline's round-to-nearest ones. R1 beat V3 on KL with the same GDN precision; this isolates how much of that comes from the quantizer rather than the topology, at V0's speed and memory.

execution.packed_wide: NVFP4 if free VRAM at load > payload + 3 GiB, else Q4_K(nvfp4)
